title: Pure Tistina
summary: Tistina cards only, with generic staples. Tistina is an Aqua Xyz strategy whose Level 10 gods flip the opponent's monsters face-down and send all face-up cards they control to the GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fallen of the Tistina sends itself from the hand or field to the GY to place Divine Domain Baatistina directly from the Deck into the Field Zone.

Miasma Dragon Tistina searches any other Tistina monster when Normal or Special Summoned, and revives itself from the GY while a card is in the Field Zone (locking you to Special Summoning Tistina monsters from the Deck or Extra Deck for the turn).
Sentinel of the Tistina Special Summons itself from the hand or GY if you control a LIGHT Tistina, then destroys 1 Tistina monster or face-down card you control to search any Tistina card.

summary.title: Opening: Fallen of the Tistina
steps: Send Fallen of the Tistina from the hand to the GY to place Divine Domain Baatistina in the Field Zone.

Activate Baatistina to send Miasma Dragon Tistina (or Hound of the Tistina) from the Deck to the GY; if the opponent controls 3 or more face-up cards, Baatistina also Special Summons Crystal God Tistina from the hand or Deck.

Revive Miasma Dragon Tistina from the GY while Baatistina is in the Field Zone to search Demigod of the Tistina, then Special Summon Demigod as a Level 10 and search Breath of the Tistina or Embrace of the Tistina.

summary.title: Crystal God & Demigod Board Wipe
summary.text: Crystal God Tistina flips all monsters the opponent controls face-down during your Main Phase, then sends all face-up cards they control to the GY without targeting or destroying. While you control Crystal God Tistina, Demigod of the Tistina gains that exact same board-flip and face-up send as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Rank 10 Payoff & OTK Push
points: Tistina, the Divinity that Defies Darkness (Rank 10 from 2 Level 10 monsters: Demigod, Crystal God, or Signs of the Tistina) sends all face-down cards the opponent controls to the GY when Special Summoned, clearing everything Crystal God or Demigod just flipped face-down.

While Divinity has Crystal God Tistina as Xyz Material, it can detach 1 material to gain 2000 ATK (reaching 4000 ATK), and if destroyed by the opponent while it has material, it revives a Tistina from the GY.

Hound of the Tistina summons itself from the hand or GY and lets all your Tistina monsters attack directly while the opponent controls a face-down monster; Tainted of the Tistina can Tribute Summon itself by Tributing 1 face-down monster the opponent controls and attacks twice when Normal Summoned; Returned of the Tistina matches another Tistina's Level for Rank 10 plays or attaches itself from the GY to an Aqua Xyz.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Breath of the Tistina grants an extra Tistina Normal Summon and flips 1 face-up monster on the field (or your own monster if you control a LIGHT Tistina) face-down to search any Tistina card.
Play of the Tistina is a Quick-Play that Special Summons a Tistina from the hand or GY in Defense Position, putting Crystal God on the field so Demigod's Quick Effect goes live.

Embrace of the Tistina flips an opponent's monster that activates its effect on the field face-down and takes control of a face-down monster in the End Phase; Discordance of the Tistina banishes the opponent's entire GY face-down; Signs of the Tistina summons itself as a Level 10 LIGHT Aqua monster.

Crystal God Tistina
Flips their monsters face-down and sends their face-up cards to the GY.
Sentinel of the Tistina
Summons itself; destroys your own Tistina or face-down card to search.
Hound of the Tistina
Summons itself from the hand or GY; Tistinas attack directly past face-down monsters.
Returned of the Tistina
Summons itself at another Tistina's Level; attaches itself to an Aqua Xyz.

Tributes one of their face-down monsters to Tribute Summon itself.
Divine Domain Baatistina
Field Spell: mills a Tistina and summons Crystal God Tistina from the Deck.
Breath of the Tistina
Extra Tistina Normal Summon; flips a monster face-down to search.
Play of the Tistina
Quick-Play: summons a Tistina from the hand or GY until the End Phase.
